mechanism: SortDropAreas applies a generic Array/List sort (direct `bl`, no blr) to the static candidate drop-area list using a static comparer field; the comparer's declaring type/Compare body is not identified in this pass.

GetMostRelevantDropAreaUnderPosition walks the already-sorted candidate list with a plain List<T> enumerator (direct `bl` to MoveNext/get_Current/Dispose, no blr) and returns the FIRST drop area for which the predicate call at 0x23544e0 (consistent with LevelDropAreaQuery.IsDroppableUnderItem per the existing contract) returns true.

Hitbox priority among overlapping drop areas = sort order established once by SortDropAreas; ties/overlaps are resolved purely by that fixed order, not by any score computed in GetMostRelevantDropAreaUnderPosition itself.
